code.commit_subject: variants FINDINGS 3: unseen-bench bug + fix, baselines (seed 175/200 vs supervised 134/200), control rows

conclusion: Recorded arena row under the B2 convention (anytime, no prefix-check).
variant_conclusion: The richer vocabulary alone did not help under plain supervision - the networks never learned to rank the new plan steps. It paid off only later, when self-play generated its own training examples of them.
variant_description: We gave the backward planner a richer vocabulary of subgoals - called B2: extra plan steps like 'park this robot out of the way for later' - and trained it on perfect examples of that richer language, hoping for shorter solutions. Technically: supervised pairs on exact B2 corpora, benched without the usual pre-filter (parked plans cannot be pre-checked).
